slides.say: For every number x, five times diamond of x, minus three x, is equal to eight plus four times diamond of x. Diamond of four is equal to what?
Diamond of x appears on both sides of the equation. This type is very rare on the exam, but it's good to know. [short pause] We'll treat diamond of x like an unknown, and isolate it.

[short pause] Think of diamond of x as one unknown, like a box. On the left there are five boxes, and on the right there are four boxes. Let's move the four boxes to the left side. Subtracting four boxes from both sides leaves five boxes minus four boxes on the left.
Five boxes minus four boxes is one box. So diamond of x minus three x is equal to eight. Now add three x to both sides, and diamond of x is three x plus eight. Now it's an ordinary definition.
Now put four into the same template. Three times four is twelve, and twelve plus eight is twenty. Choice number two is our answer. [pause] Okay. I'll see you in the next question.
